notes.title: Insurrection Closed Alpha Playtest!
notes.content:
The closed alpha for Insurrection is here! The alpha is open to a small subset of players who will be able to play a pre-release demo of the game and provide feedback. If you're interested, please request access and provide some detailed feedback on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3282640/discussions/]Community page![/url]

Help me shape the future of Insurrection and make the experience the best it can possibly be
